reviewer: Implementing worker source self-review; independent native/semantic qualification remains separate
scope: Narrow frozen runtime change review; only this receipt is written. No code/build edits, native replay or additional tests. The running full verifier is owned by root.

checks.basis: The guard catches only FileNotFoundError and returns. lock retains mkdir for initialization, while load retains its existing store_read wrapper for a missing head. It does not create directories during load.
checks.execution: Covered by test_missing_and_unreadable_heads_keep_store_read_error and existing initialization tests.

checks.case: Observed head file or unrelated regular file
checks.basis: stat mode rejects non-directories before mkdir/os.open. It neither uses the filename suffix nor substitutes the parent; file bytes/mtime and existing state/history are preserved.
checks.execution: New direct lock/load/initialize/commit subcases and real CLI/MCP commit regression.

checks.basis: Type is determined by stat.S_ISDIR, so a directory called state.px remains valid. PX1/PX2 publication and direct state-file validation work.

stat follows the target, and lock already resolved the path before this change. A symlink to a directory remains a directory; a symlink resolving to a file is rejected. load uses the supplied path as before. This adds no symlink confinement or atomic identity guarantee.
checks.execution: No new live symlink probe; existing lock/history symlink regressions were skipped for Windows privilege in the focused suite.

checks.case: Permission failure during stat or head read
checks.basis: The guard does not swallow PermissionError. lock retains the OSError path; load catches OSError inside its existing try and retains store_read with the original cause. PixlError inherits ValueError, so a genuine store_directory diagnostic is not wrapped as store_read.
checks.execution: Head read denial was executed through a mock; permission denial specifically during stat was reasoned from control flow, not separately executed.

checks.case: Non-directory ancestor, dangling link, or replacement after stat
checks.basis: Only a successfully observed non-directory final locator gets the new error. Other OS failures are not broadly converted. Existing resolution/mkdir/open/read behavior still decides races or unresolved paths; no automatic parent substitution, retry or stale-lock removal was introduced.
checks.execution: No additional race/ancestor/dangling-link experiment; existing concurrent publication and lock regressions remain the executed scope.

checks.basis: Shared load covers jobs/delivery reads preceding publication; shared lock covers commit/init/completion. Both report the same precise file-locator error.
checks.execution: Jobs dispatch, delivery snapshot and task completion negative cases, plus direct store operations.

checks.basis: The new diagnostic is keyed only by store_directory. Existing store_locked recovery and owner observation remain unchanged; an unrelated publication FileExistsError retains the prior generic OS category.
checks.execution: New category separation test and existing actual CLI/MCP locked-commit tests.

checks.basis: Shared lock is also used for derived .pixl/plar-lock and .pixl/handoffs directories. If one is an existing file, the new error says it must be a directory containing state.px and recovery tells the caller to correct a store argument. Those auxiliary locations need not contain state.px and these operations may have no supplied store argument.
checks.execution: Source inspection only; not a newly executed failing test.
checks.recommendation: Use accurate shared-directory wording or explicit caller context while keeping the targeted store/head distinction and all actual lock/read categories. Do not silently choose a parent directory or broadly classify FileExistsError.

checks.basis: All store arguments in CLI/MCP discovery receive the same description, including nested PLAR prepare. Only descriptive schema metadata changes; parameter types, required fields, PX1/PX2 registry/encoding and publication transitions remain unchanged.
checks.execution: Immediate CLI help and all discovered store descriptions tested; both saved-format publication/validation cases passed.

finding_scope: Precision of the newly introduced recovery for auxiliary lock directories; the targeted head-file rejection and preservation checks pass.
